findings.title: Ambulance Traffic Diverted, Clinical Appointments Cancelled and Classes Cancelled Due to Cybersecurity Issue at UNM HSC
findings.summary_md: UNM Health Sciences Center officials announced a cybersecurity issue requiring diversion of all ambulances and cancellation of all clinic appointments, while hospitals remained open and nonessential staff and students were sent home. The notice stated that IT security teams contained the event and notified state and federal law enforcement.

findings.title: UNM Health cybersecurity threat: Ambulances diverted, clinics closed, students sent home
findings.summary_md: KOB 4 reported that a cybersecurity threat affecting the entire UNM Health Sciences Center diverted ambulances to other hospitals, closed all clinics, and sent some students home on Monday. UNM limited new patient admissions from 12:30 to 2:30 p.m., suspended outpatient surgeries and appointments, and canceled classes at its four health sciences schools while stating its hospitals remained open.

findings.title: UNM Health cyberattack cancels appointments, diverts ambulances
findings.summary_md: The Albuquerque Journal reported that a cybersecurity threat canceled appointments at UNM Health clinics statewide and diverted ambulances to other Albuquerque-area hospitals. All appointments and outpatient surgeries at more than 30 UNM Health System clinics across New Mexico were canceled Monday.

findings.title: Cybersecurity issue forces New Mexico hospital to divert patients and close clinics
findings.summary_md: AP/ABC News reported that a major New Mexico hospital network was racing to fix a cybersecurity issue that forced ambulances to other hospitals and canceled appointments at more than 30 clinics. The network operates the state's only Level 1 trauma center and handles about 900,000 outpatient visits and 100,000 emergency room visits annually.

findings.title: Cyberattack disrupts University of New Mexico hospitals, extortion group claims attack
findings.summary_md: Help Net Security reported that UNM Health Sciences Center suffered a cyberattack temporarily disrupting hospital operations, with an extortion group claiming responsibility. The group asserted on its leak site that it compromised 36,000 machines across campus and hospital environments and exfiltrated student, employee, and patient data.

findings.title: University of New Mexico hospital diverts ambulances after cyberattack
findings.summary_md: The Record reported that ambulances were diverted from the UNM Health System after a Monday cyberattack and that a ransomware gang known as BYOD took credit Monday evening, claiming 36,000 compromised machines and stolen student, patient, and employee data. UNM said it suffered a cyberattack on Monday and notified federal law enforcement, and its spokesperson did not confirm ransomware.

findings.title: Cyber Incident Forces UNM Health to Cancel Surgeries, Divert Ambulances
findings.summary_md: Infosecurity Magazine reported that UNM was restoring systems after an incident claimed by the BYOD ransomware group, with VenariX noting the group listed UNM on its data leak site. The report cited claims of 36,000 compromised machines and exfiltration of sensitive data.
